proposal.summary: Neo Billing version 3.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in ticket input fields (Subject/Description) allowing attacker-supplied HTML/JavaScript to be stored and later rendered.
proposal.cwe_quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.

AC.quote: Due to improper input fields data filtering, version 3.5 (and possibly previous versions), are affected by a stored XSS vulnerability.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce by logging in as a customer and submitting the provided payload to /neo/crm/tickets/addticket. If confirmed, sanitize/validate input and/or apply proper HTML output encoding for ticket title and content, and release a patch for 3.5 (and earlier affected versions).
